common: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one individual Bible verse painting for Scripture for Life, landscape 3:2. Match the reference watercolor: fine translucent washes, ivory paper texture, naturally detailed olive trees and grasses, layered sage and forest-green hills, restrained warm gold light, soft blue atmospheric distance. verses.scene: Psalm 5:1: An anonymous ancient traveler kneels beside a low stone wall in a quiet olive grove at earliest dawn, bowed head and open hands expressing words and wordless groaning, subdued and honest, distant blue hills.

Psalm 5:2: An anonymous ancient worshiper stands on a hill overlooking an ancient stone town at dawn, hands lifted modestly in earnest appeal, humble posture expressing a cry addressed to God as King, no throne or divine person.

Psalm 5:3: At daybreak an anonymous traveler sits facing the brightening eastern sky beside a small clay lamp that has burned through the night, expectant stillness, olive valley and distant blue hills, prayer and waiting.

Psalm 5:4: A quiet ancient stone doorway opens into a clean sunlit courtyard with an olive tree; outside, the path lies in deep shadow with a discarded broken weapon on the ground. A symbolic contrast of God's goodness and evil without implying darkness itself is evil, no divine figure.

Psalm 5:5: A lone richly dressed anonymous ancient figure stands at a distance outside a modest stone courtyard, proud upright posture now paused and diminished by the vast sky, olive hills. Sober meditation on arrogance and accountability, no caricature, no humiliation.

Psalm 5:6: A broken dagger and snapped wax seal lie abandoned beside a dry thorn branch on an ancient roadside; beyond, a clear path leads toward a quiet village in morning light. Sober symbolic painting of bloodshed and deceit rejected, no blood, bodies or gore.

Psalm 5:7: An anonymous ancient worshiper bows respectfully at a modest ancient sanctuary entrance, warm light within, olive trees outside, broad open space expressing welcome and reverence. Imagined sanctuary, not Solomon's temple, no giant columns or historically claimed reconstruction.

Psalm 5:8: An anonymous traveler at a fork in a rugged olive valley turns toward a straight well-lit footpath while darker winding tracks fade away between rocks, steady morning light, prayer for righteous direction, no signs or words.

Psalm 5:9: An old empty weathered stone tomb entrance at a distance beside a village lane, foreground a tangled thorn branch, beyond a clear path and olive hills. Symbolic painting of destructive deceitful speech, sober subdued greens, no skulls, bodies or text.

Psalm 5:10: A tangled net abandoned on a rocky ancient path catches its own collapsed wooden supports, the path beyond open in cool morning light. Symbolic wrongdoers caught in their own devices, a prayer for justice, no people harmed, no weapons or divine person.

Psalm 5:11: A small group of ancient travelers rests and sings softly beneath the broad shelter of a great olive tree after rain, lifted faces and quiet joy, green valley with sunlight returning, expressive shelter and shared refuge, no musical text.

Psalm 5:12: A simple worn round shield leans beside a seated anonymous traveler under an olive tree, luminous morning sky and green hills surrounding the peaceful scene, symbolic favor as a protective shield, humble and calm, no visible divinity.
